author: CoolVision
description:
Zimbabwe is NOTHING like I expected. Is Zimbabwe safe for tourists? What is it actually like to travel here? In this Zimbabwe travel guide and travel documentary, we journey deep across the country to discover its vibrant cities, ancient history, breathtaking landscapes, diverse wildlife, and incredible people.

Our African adventure begins in Harare, the capital city of Zimbabwe, before heading into the Eastern Highlands. We explore the wilderness of Nyanga National Park, take on the thrilling giant swing and zipline at Far and Wide, and travel through the spectacular Honde Valley. Along the way, we meet Tinashe, a Zimbabwean winemaker who shares his inspiring story. At Aberfoyle, we tour the lush tea fields and factory to learn how Zimbabwean tea is produced and exported around the world. We also visit the Vumba region to experience its misty mountain landscapes and local coffee estates.

The journey then takes us to Chishakwe in the Save Valley Conservancy for a true wildlife safar
title: The Real Zimbabwe (NOTHING Like I Expected)
